home.name: Home
home.description: You are in your house. Your older brother is unconscious on the bed. The exit door is to the north.

items.name: Rations
items.description: A pack of rations. Use this item to restore 10 health.

items.name: Map
items.description: A map of the surrounding area. Use this item to reveal the layout of the province.

items.name: Coin Pouch
items.description: A small pouch filled with coins. Use this item to gain 50 gold.

road2.name: Main Road (2)
road2.description: You are on the main road. The forest around you is quiet. The main road leads north and a dirt path leads west.

lake2.name: Lake (2)
lake2.description: You are at the end of the lake. The waters are calm and the surroundings are peaceful. A dirt path leads east.
